definitions.ask: Should each safe Schema Card gesture commit immediately as its own scoped commit?
definitions.why: Matches bob's one-writer transaction model and keeps every schema change independently revertable

choices.label: One scoped commit per gesture; Undo replays inverse ops; history stays honest and revertable
The card batches edits into a draft; one commit per explicit save; Undo exists only pre-save

definitions.ask: Should album schema surfaces degrade gracefully on Obsidian mobile?
definitions.why: Follows the album service's existing desktop-gated subprocess pattern at little extra cost

choices.label: Header and chips render read-only on mobile with an edit-in-YAML hint; no subprocess writes
Desktop-only; on mobile the native record row stays visible and untouched

definitions.ask: Should Ctrl+Shift+P open the Schema Card on album notes, where the Task Card chord is idle?
definitions.why: The chord is otherwise idle on album notes and the mnemonic stays coherent

choices.label: The Task Card chord opens the Schema Card on album notes, editing the properties of what you are on
The Schema Card opens only from the header, the command palette, and Command Mode
